duration: Variable; approvals, downloads and restart may take much longer
summary: Phases 0-3. Select the approved local Workstation setup agent once, or use manual tasks. Existing tools are retained before downloads; checkmarks are not laptop acceptance.
action_notice: Only human-selected local Workstation setup may execute scoped approved setup/Restore/launch stages. Ordinary agents remain blocked. HTML never executes; no policy bypass or blind legacy resume.

steps.title: Approve prerequisites and review the clone
steps.where: IT review › VS Code › Source Control
do: Confirm serviced Windows 11, virtualization, disk budget, App Installer/WinGet, approved Git/VS Code, source/profile policy and private-repo access.
Save work; never update or switch an active/dirty/shared clone.
steps.see: A reviewed safe main checkout and explicit prerequisite decisions, not installed-state proof.

steps.title: Select Workstation setup and send one start request
steps.where: Local Windows VS Code Chat › Agent dropdown
do: Choose Workstation setup on the reviewed clone, not a cloud/remote or delegated agent.
It inventories first and drives existing terminal tools; you approve changes and answer native prompts. The remaining task steps are the manual fallback.
steps.warn: Missing tools/interactive prompts block execution; do not enable autoapprove.
steps.see: Local demo and full workstation readiness remain distinct. Live agent/tool use still needs human acceptance.

steps.title: Run read-only Preflight
do: Use 5 seconds normally, or the same approved slow HTTPS selection for Preflight and the following named setup.
Require no FAIL and exit 0. Missing pre-setup WSL outputs may be expected warnings.
steps.see: Actual prerequisite results, not installation or authentication.

steps.title: Manual fallback: preview the one module you need
do: Choose Core/Python/Java/Go/Extensions/WSL/Ubuntu/Docker/Modernization explicitly.
Inventory all targets before any payload/source/provider/installer activity; installed compatible targets skip, unknown/incompatible stops.
steps.warn: Ordinary coding/build/desktop/cloud agents never execute preview/WhatIf.
steps.see: Version/location-aware retained targets and only approved missing targets.

steps.title: Confirm only needed Core installs
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Install core tools
do: Review local inventory and the single-module confirmation.
Keep existing versions/settings. Normal Core is not the legacy Microsoft bundle.
steps.see: Per-target retained/installed/stopped outcomes; no blanket success.

steps.title: Choose missing SDKs independently
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Install Python SDK / Install Java SDK / Install Go SDK
do: Choose only the needed named SDK: Python 3.14, current JDK 25, manifest-defined Go 1.27.3.
Known registrations/paths can find Python/pwsh despite stale VS Code PATH; unknown inventory stops without downloads.
steps.see: Each SDK has its own reviewed result; no automatic upgrade or runtime substitution.

steps.title: Attest and install approved missing extensions
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Install extensions (approved source)
do: Human/IT must attest existing CLI/default-profile routing before the approved-source task.
Keep account/profile/source policy; unsupported private-marketplace routing stops acceptance.
steps.warn: No public VSIX, profile/source switch or manual-install workaround.
steps.see: Twelve required extensions still need enabled-state/profile acceptance in Phase 3.

steps.title: Review WSL features and restart state
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Install WSL components
do: Use an approved Administrator context when required; no automatic elevation.
Pause on pending restart, retain existing runtime/distros/data and do not reset/update/launch a distro.
steps.see: Explicit WSL/component outcomes or a stopped-for-restart result, not completed runtime acceptance.

steps.title: Decide optional modules, then observe outcomes
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Optional named module
do: Ubuntu is separate after WSL readiness. Docker needs licensing; modernization is explicit Java 11 plus optional extension.
Wait for a known vendor outcome; timeout/cancellation is uncertain, never a blind retry.
steps.warn: Finish setup/SkipBase are legacy-only after successful base plus reboot/resume, not stopped-partial recovery.
steps.see: Retained tools/settings/accounts and a truthful per-module result.

steps.title: Refresh, Verify and accept the intended profile
steps.where: Save work › Fully exit/reopen VS Code › Verify
do: Reopen from Windows for fresh environment values when needed; new terminal/Reload Window is not guaranteed.
Require post-setup Verify exit 0 plus actual enabled extensions, correct profile and approved source acceptance.
steps.see: Real readiness evidence; missing required results mean not accepted.
